nodes.name: Webhook: /scrape-complete
nodes.notes: Called directly by scraper/main.py notify_n8n('scrape_done', ...) after every scrape.

parameters.query:
SELECT id, project_id, competitor_id, post_text
FROM posts
WHERE project_id = '{{ $json.body.project_id }}'
AND ai_analysed = false
LIMIT 50

UPDATE posts SET
  main_topic = '{{ $json.main_topic }}',
  sub_topic = {{ $json.sub_topic ? "'" + $json.sub_topic + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  keywords = '{{ JSON.stringify($json.keywords || []) }}'::jsonb,
  content_type = '{{ $json.content_type }}',
  cta_type = '{{ $json.cta_type }}',
  has_promotion = {{ $json.has_promotion ? 'true' : 'false' }},
  ai_analysed = true
WHERE id = '{{ $('Split In Batches (5)').item.json.id }}'
